name: Olopat Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About OLOPAT EYE DROPS

OLOPAT EYE DROPS contains Olopatadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis. Seasonal allergic conjunctivitis is an eye inflammation caused due to exposure of eye(s) towards various allergens such as pollens, dusts or molds etc. Symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis may include eye redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production.

Olopatadine is a H1 histamine receptor antagonist. When applied to the eyes, it blocks the release of certain chemicals (Ex. histamines) in the eyes that causes allergic reactions. As a result, it manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).

Use OLOPAT EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOPAT EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOPAT EYE DROPS.

Before using OLOPAT EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. OLOPAT EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children aged below 3 years.

OLOPAT EYE DROPS may make your vision blur after application. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until your vision becomes clear. The most common side effects of using OLOPAT EYE DROPS are eye pain or irritation, eye dryness, abnormal sensation in the eyes, headache, dry nose and changes in taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis
usesDetails:
Uses Of OLOPAT EYE DROPS
Manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis
mechanismOfAction:
How OLOPAT EYE DROPS Works

OLOPAT EYE DROPS is an anti-allergic agent. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (such as histamines) in the eye that causes eye inflammation and irritation. As a result, it manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).
usageDetails:
How to use OLOPAT EYE DROPS

Apply OLOPAT EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes.

Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of OLOPAT EYE DROPS as directed by your physician. Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same in the other eye if required.

Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOPAT EYE DROPS. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOPAT EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion.

While application, do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.
sideEffects: Eyelid abnormality, swelling or crusting of the eyelid

name: Amplinak Ophthalmic Suspension 5ml
packInfo: Pet bottle of 5 ml ophthalmic suspension
introduction:
Introduction About AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION

AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION contains Nepafenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in adults to manage eye pain and eye inflammation following cataract surgery. It can also be used to manage the risk of macular edema (swelling at the back of the eye) following cataract surgery in diabetic patients.

AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is for ophthalmic use only. Use AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION as instructed by the physician to achieve better results. Avoid wearing contact lenses after undergoing cataract surgery. Your doctor will advise you when you can use contact lenses again.

Before using AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have diabetes, arthritis or bleeding problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from inflammation (such as eye infections, glaucoma etc.).

AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION.

AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. The most common side effects of using AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION are visual disturbances, sensation of a foreign body in the eye and eye irritation. Contact your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage and manage eye pain and inflammation following cataract surgery
Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients

How AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION Works

AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is an analgesic medication. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) in the eye that causes inflammation, pain and swelling. As a result, it provides relief from post-surgical eye pain, inflammation and swelling.

How to use AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION

Use AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only.

Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes. Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of the medicine as directed by your physician.

Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required.

Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Severe eye pain with redness (inflammation of iris)

Common

warnings.details: AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, inform your doctor before using AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION.
AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience blurred vision after using AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION. Wait, until your vision becomes clear.
Do not use AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION if you are allergic to nepafenac or to other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (such as ibuprofen, aspirin, piroxicam, ketoprofen, diclofenac).

AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients who previously developed asthma while using any non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Others

AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is not recommended for use if you:

Had previously experienced any skin allergy or intense inflammation in your nose following the use of any pain relieving medicines

Before using AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you:

Bruise easily or have any bleeding problems
Have an eye infection or any other eye disorders
Have diabetes
Have rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints)
Have had repeated eye surgery within a short period of time

Use in pediatrics:

AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Use in geriatrics:

AMPLINAK OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

name: Megabrom Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About MEGABROM EYE DROPS

MEGABROM EYE DROPS contains Bromfenac, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). It is used in adults for the management of postoperative inflammation and reduction of postoperative eye pain in patients who have undergone cataract surgery.

Cataract can be defined as a condition in which the lens of the eye becomes progressively opaque or cloudy. Symptoms include blurred vision, sensitivity to light/glare, poor night vision, seeing halos around lights, and double vision.

MEGABROM EYE DROPS should be used with caution in patients having bleeding problems (Ex. haemophilia), rheumatoid arthritis, diabetes, or eye problems (Ex. dry eye syndrome, corneal problems, repeated eye surgery in a short time). Do not wear contact lenses while using the medicine.

MEGABROM EYE DROPS should not be used during the last three months of pregnancy, and your doctor may advise you to use this medicine only if needed. It can be used in breast-feeding women.

MEGABROM EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. There is no evidence of safety for MEGABROM EYE DROPS in elderly patients above 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before using it.

The most common side effects of using MEGABROM EYE DROPS are increased sensitivity of eyes to light, eye pain, and blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage postoperative inflammation and reduction of postoperative eye pain in patients who have undergone cataract surgery.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEGABROM EYE DROPS
Manage postoperative inflammation and reduction of postoperative eye pain in patients who have undergone cataract surgery.
mechanismOfAction:
How MEGABROM EYE DROPS Works

MEGABROM EYE DROPS effectively blocks the synthesis of certain substances involved in causing inflammation (prostaglandin). Hence reducing the pain and inflammation after the patient has undergone cataract surgery.
usageDetails:
How to use MEGABROM EYE DROPS

Use MEGABROM EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. While using MEGABROM EYE DROPS, tilt your head back and pull down your lower eyelid. Make sure you wash your hands and do not touch any surface while using it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CYCLOMUNE 0.05% EYE DROPS

CYCLOMUNE 0.05% EYE DROPS contains Cyclosporin which belongs to the group of medicines called Immunosuppressants.  It is used to manage severe dry eye syndrome (keratoconjunctivitis sicca) in children and in adolescents (aged between 4-18 years).

Dry Eye Syndrome (also known as keratoconjunctivitis sicca) is an allergic eye condition that affects the transparent layer in the front part of the eye and the thin membrane covering the front part of the eye. It is characterized by excessive eye dryness, redness, itching, inflammation and discomfort. Persons having dry eye syndrome do not produce sufficient tears to lubricate and nourish the eyes.

CYCLOMUNE 0.05% EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before and after application. Avoid touching the tip of the container with your mouth, nose or other parts of body to avoid contamination.

If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using CYCLOMUNE 0.05% EYE DROPS. Consult your doctor about the usage of contact lenses while undergoing management for dry eyes.

Before using CYCLOMUNE 0.05% EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any other eye conditions apart from dry eye syndrome such as eye infection or glaucoma. CYCLOMUNE 0.05% EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients having cancer in and around the eye areas. Consult your doctor before using CYCLOMUNE 0.05% EYE DROPS if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using CYCLOMUNE 0.05% EYE DROPS are eye pain, redness, irritation or discomfort, watery eyes and blurred vision. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage severe dry eye syndrome
usesDetails:
Uses Of CYCLOMUNE 0.05% EYE DROPS
Manage severe dry eye syndrome
mechanismOfAction:
How CYCLOMUNE 0.05% EYE DROPS Works

CYCLOMUNE 0.05% EYE DROPS is an immunosuppressive agent. Following application on the eyes, it blocks the release of certain chemicals in the eye (such as T-cells, interleukins and cytokines) that causes eye inflammation, allergies and discomfort. As a result, it reduces inflammation and swelling on the eye and keeps your eyes lubricated by allowing your eye to produce tears.
usageDetails:
How to use CYCLOMUNE 0.05% EYE DROPS

Use CYCLOMUNE 0.05% EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes.

Gently pull your lower eyelid and instil few drops of the medicine as directed by your physician. Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required.

Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination. Avoid wearing contact lenses while undergoing therapy for dry eyes.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop using CYCLOMUNE 0.05% EYE DROPS unless your doctor tells you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About PATADAY OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION

PATADAY OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION contains Olopatadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis. Seasonal allergic conjunctivitis is an eye inflammation caused due to exposure of eye(s) towards various allergens such as pollens, dusts or molds etc. Symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis may include eye redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production.

Olopatadine is a H1 histamine receptor antagonist. When applied to the eyes, it blocks the release of certain chemicals (Ex. histamines) in the eyes that causes allergic reactions. As a result, it manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).

Use PATADAY OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION as advised by your physician. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using PATADAY OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying PATADAY OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION.

Before using PATADAY OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION inform your doctor if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. PATADAY OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children aged below 3 years.

PATADAY OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION may make your vision blur after application. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until your vision becomes clear. The most common side effects of using PATADAY OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION are eye pain or irritation, eye dryness, abnormal sensation in the eyes, headache, dry nose and changes in taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About NEXANAC OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION

NEXANAC OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION contains Nepafenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in adults to manage eye pain and eye inflammation following cataract surgery. It can also be used to manage the risk of macular edema (swelling at the back of the eye) following cataract surgery in diabetic patients.

NEXANAC OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is for ophthalmic use only. Use NEXANAC OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION as instructed by the physician to achieve better results. Avoid wearing contact lenses after undergoing cataract surgery. Your doctor will advise you when you can use contact lenses again.

Before using NEXANAC OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have diabetes, arthritis or bleeding problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from inflammation (such as eye infections, glaucoma etc.).

NEXANAC OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEXANAC OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION.

NEXANAC OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. The most common side effects of using NEXANAC OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION are visual disturbances, sensation of a foreign body in the eye and eye irritation. Contact your doctor if they trouble you.

name: Beipos Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About BEIPOS EYE DROPS

BEIPOS EYE DROPS contains Bepotastine which belongs to the group of medicines called as Antihistamines. It is indicated in the management of itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis.

Allergic conjunctivitis is a common allergic condition of the eye affecting the outer lining of the eye (conjunctiva) to the particles in the surroundings to which a person is allergic. It can appear as red, watery, itchy, or swollen eyes.

If you use contact lenses, you should remove the contact lenses before using BEIPOS EYE DROPS and can put them back after 10 minutes of use.

Before using BEIPOS EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart or lung diseases.

BEIPOS EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children below 2 years of age. Prior consultation must be taken for the use of BEIPOS EYE DROPS in pregnant and breast-feeding women.

The most common side effects of using BEIPOS EYE DROPS are mild taste, irritation in the eyes, headache, swelling of nose and throat from inside. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these doesn’t improve or worsen.
uses: Used to manage itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis
usesDetails:
Uses Of BEIPOS EYE DROPS
Used to manage itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis
mechanismOfAction:
How BEIPOS EYE DROPS Works

BEIPOS EYE DROPS belongs to antihistamines which blocks a certain chemical called histamine which is responsible for the allergic reaction. It also supresses the movement of certain cells (eosinophils) into the inflamed (red, swollen) tissue to manage tissue damage and worsening of allergic inflammation of the outer lining of the eyeball.
usageDetails:
How to use BEIPOS EYE DROPS

Use BEIPOS EYE DROPS as advised by your doctor. It is for ophthalmic use only. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, condition and body weight.

introduction:
Introduction About CAFTA EYE DROPS

CAFTA EYE DROPS contains Alcaftadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Ocular antihistamines and decongestants. It is used to manage eye itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis. Allergic conjunctivitis is an eye inflammation caused due to exposure of eye(s) towards various allergens such as pollens, dusts, or molds etc. Symptoms of allergic conjunctivitis may include eye redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production.

Alcaftadine is a H1 histamine receptor antagonist. It blocks the effects of certain chemicals (Ex. histamines) in the body which are responsible for triggering the allergic response. Therefore, when administered into the eyes, it manages the onset of allergic reactions such as eye itching, irritation or inflammation.

Do not use CAFTA EYE DROPS while wearing soft contact lenses. Make sure to remove them before applying CAFTA EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. CAFTA EYE DROPS should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by your physician. The use of CAFTA EYE DROPS can make you feel drowsy, and so be cautious while you perform tasks that requires complete concentration such as driving or handling heavy tools or machines. Contact your doctor if your eye condition worsens or does not improve after 3 days of use. The most common side effects of using CAFTA EYE DROPS are eye redness, itching, irritation, burning and/or stinging sensation upon use. Contact your doctor if any of them bothers you.

introduction:
Introduction About NAPZOL PLUS EYE DROPS

Napzol Plus Eye Drop is a sterile ophthalmic solution formulated with Naphazoline 0.01%. It is commonly used to manage occasional eye redness or discomfort, especially after extended screen time, exposure to dust, or seasonal changes.

Napzol Plus Eye Drops should only be used in the affected eye, following the dosage and duration recommended by your doctor. Make sure to wash your hands before applying the medication. Always read the label for specific instructions before use. Do not skip any doses, and complete the entire course of management, even if you start feeling better.

Common side effects of these drops may includes burning sensation, dry eye, irritation, itching, and redness at the application site. These are usually temporary and resolve with time. However, if they persist or get worse, inform your doctor. In case of accidental contact with your ears, nose, or mouth, immediately rinse it with water.

Let your doctor know if you have any known allergies to the ingredients in this medication or if you're taking any other medicines. It's also recommended not to drive or operate heavy machinery right after using this medication, as it may cause temporary vision blurring and impair your ability to drive.

mechanismOfAction:
How NAPZOL PLUS EYE DROPS Works

Napzol Plus Eye Drops work through a combination of mechanisms of action (MOA), each targeting specific aspects of eye irritation and discomfort:

Vasoconstrictor Action (Naphazoline): The main ingredient, Naphazoline, acts as a vasoconstrictor, meaning it narrows the blood vessels in the eye. This reduces the redness caused by dilated blood vessels, providing a clearer, less irritated appearance.
Reduces Eye Irritation: By constricting the blood vessels and reducing inflammation, Naphazoline helps alleviate minor eye irritation caused by external factors like dust, pollen, smoke, or prolonged exposure to digital screens.
Soothes Dryness and Discomfort: The drops work to relieve dry eyes by providing moisture to the surface of the eye, which soothes the sensation of dryness or tiredness, especially after prolonged exposure to air conditioning, heating, or digital screens.
Anti-inflammatory Effect: By reducing blood flow to the affected area, Naphazoline also helps to decrease inflammation, which is often responsible for the discomfort, redness, and swelling associated with eye irritation.
Fast Relief: Upon application, the drops work quickly to reduce symptoms such as redness, itching, and discomfort, offering almost immediate relief and restoring comfort to the eyes.
Convenient and Precise Application: The dropper ensures controlled, accurate application of the drops, delivering the right amount of medicine exactly where it’s needed, enhancing the effectiveness of the treatment and reducing the risk of wastage.

Together, these actions make Napzol Plus Eye Drops an effective and fast-acting solution for managing eye redness, irritation, and dryness.

Follow the instructions provided by your doctor. Avoid touching the dropper tip to any surface to maintain its sterility.

Recommended Dosage for Napzol Plus Eye Drop:

The recommended dosage will depend on the severity of your symptoms and your doctor's advice. Typically, 1-2 drops are administered in the affected eye(s) up to 3-4 times a day. Follow your doctor’s guidance carefully.

How to Apply Napzol Plus Eye Drop:

1. Wash your hands thoroughly before use.

2. Tilt your head back slightly and pull down the lower eyelid of the affected eye.

3. Hold the dropper close to your eye without touching the tip to your eye or any other surface to keep it sterile.

4. Squeeze the prescribed number of drops into the lower eyelid pocket.

5. Close your eye gently, and press lightly on the corner of your eye near the nose to prevent the drops from draining out.

6. Wash your hands again after applying the drops.

Napzol Plus Eye Drop: How Often Should You Use It?

Napzol Plus should be used as directed by your doctor. Usually, the frequency is 3-4 times daily. Do not exceed the prescribed dose or frequency to avoid any potential side effects.

Napzol Plus Eye Drop Dosage for Different Age Groups:

Dosage for children, adults, and elderly individuals will vary based on the doctor’s instructions. It’s crucial to follow age-specific dosage recommendations and avoid overuse.

Important Instructions for Using Napzol Plus Safely:
Do not use if you are allergic to any of the ingredients in the eye drop.
Always check the expiration date before use
Avoid contact with the dropper tip to reduce contamination.
Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects or discomfort.

There are no known direct interactions between alcohol and Napzol Plus Eye Drops. However, excessive alcohol consumption can cause dehydration, which may worsen dry eye symptoms. It's best to use the drops cautiously with alcohol.

More Information
01.Why Choose Napzol Plus Eye Drops Over Other Brands?

1. Effective Relief for Eye Redness and Irritation

Napzol Plus typically contains Naphazoline, an alpha-adrenergic agonist, which constricts the blood vessels in the eyes to reduce redness and irritation. If you are looking for fast-acting relief from minor eye redness caused by irritants like smoke, dust, or allergens, Napzol Plus can provide that.

2. Dual Action Formula

In addition to Naphazoline for vasoconstriction, many Napzol Plus formulations include antihistamines or other ingredients that target both the physical symptoms (like redness) and the allergic response (like itching or watery eyes). This dual-action approach could be an advantage if you suffer from both symptoms.

3. Long-Lasting Effects

Some users report that Napzol Plus offers longer-lasting relief compared to other brands, meaning fewer applications are needed throughout the day. This can be more convenient for people who need sustained symptom control.

4. Convenient and Portable

Like many other eye drop brands, Napzol Plus comes in small, portable bottles that can easily fit into a pocket or purse. If you're someone who needs quick relief on the go, this could be a major advantage.

5. Lower Cost vs. Prescription Alternatives

Depending on where you live, Napzol Plus may be more affordable than prescription medications, making it a practical over-the-counter option for people who want relief without the higher cost associated with some other prescription managements.

6. Fewer Ingredients (for Sensitive Eyes)

Napzol Plus may have fewer ingredients or preservatives compared to other formulations, making it suitable for people with more sensitive eyes. This can reduce the likelihood of irritation or unwanted reactions from extra additives.

7. Brand Reputation

If you trust the manufacturer or have had a good experience with other products from that brand, it might influence your decision. Some brands build up a reputation for reliability and consistency, which can be a factor when choosing a product.

Comprehensive Relief: The combination of Naphazoline with antihistamines (when included) provides more than just temporary redness relief, it's also effective for addressing underlying irritation and allergy-related symptoms.

Suitable for Severe Cases: For severe irritation, allergies, or dry eyes, Napzol Plus is a reliable and effective choice. Natural remedies might help with minor discomfort but are generally not potent enough for more serious eye conditions.

When Might You Prefer Natural Remedies?

Mild Redness or Irritation: If you’re looking for a soothing, all-natural approach and have only mild symptoms, natural remedies like cucumber slices or tea bags could be sufficient.
Chronic, Long-Term Use: Some people prefer natural remedies for ongoing maintenance, especially when they're not dealing with severe or acute issues, and they may want to avoid pharmaceutical options.
Sensitive Skin: If you have sensitive skin or eyes, you might prefer natural remedies that are less likely to contain chemicals or preservatives.

Conclusion:

Napzol Plus offers a faster, more targeted, and longer-lasting solution compared to natural remedies, making it the better option for quick relief from eye redness and irritation. However, for mild discomfort or occasional irritation, natural remedies can still be a good, soothing choice.

name: Olopine Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About OLOPINE EYE DROPS

OLOPINE EYE DROPS contains Olopatadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis. Seasonal allergic conjunctivitis is an eye inflammation caused due to exposure of eye(s) towards various allergens such as pollens, dusts or molds etc. Symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis may include eye redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production.

Olopatadine is a H1 histamine receptor antagonist. When applied to the eyes, it blocks the release of certain chemicals (Ex. histamines) in the eyes that causes allergic reactions. As a result, it manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).

Use OLOPINE EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOPINE EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOPINE EYE DROPS.

Before using OLOPINE EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. OLOPINE EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children aged below 3 years.

OLOPINE EYE DROPS may make your vision blur after application. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until your vision becomes clear. The most common side effects of using OLOPINE EYE DROPS are eye pain or irritation, eye dryness, abnormal sensation in the eyes, headache, dry nose and changes in taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

usageDetails:
How to use OLOPINE EYE DROPS

Apply OLOPINE EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes.

Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of OLOPINE EYE DROPS as directed by your physician. Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same in the other eye if required.

Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOPINE EYE DROPS. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOPINE EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion.

While application, do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

name: Cyclomune 0.1% Eye Drops 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS

CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS contains Cyclosporin which belongs to the group of medicines called Immunosuppressants.  It is used to manage severe dry eye syndrome (keratoconjunctivitis sicca) in children and in adolescents (aged between 4-18 years).

Dry Eye Syndrome (also known as keratoconjunctivitis sicca) is an allergic eye condition that affects the transparent layer in the front part of the eye and the thin membrane covering the front part of the eye. It is characterized by excessive eye dryness, redness, itching, inflammation and discomfort. Persons having dry eye syndrome do not produce sufficient tears to lubricate and nourish the eyes.

CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before and after application. Avoid touching the tip of the container with your mouth, nose or other parts of body to avoid contamination.

If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS. Consult your doctor about the usage of contact lenses while undergoing management for dry eyes.

Before using CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any other eye conditions apart from dry eye syndrome such as eye infection or glaucoma. CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients having cancer in and around the eye areas. Consult your doctor before using CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS are eye pain, redness, irritation or discomfort, watery eyes and blurred vision. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage severe dry eye syndrome
usesDetails:
Uses Of CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS
Manage severe dry eye syndrome
mechanismOfAction:
How CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS Works

CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS is an immunosuppressive agent. Following application on the eyes, it blocks the release of certain chemicals in the eye (such as T-cells, interleukins and cytokines) that causes eye inflammation, allergies and discomfort. As a result, it reduces inflammation and swelling on the eye and keeps your eyes lubricated by allowing your eye to produce tears.
usageDetails:
How to use CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS

Use CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes.

Gently pull your lower eyelid and instil few drops of the medicine as directed by your physician. Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required.

Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination. Avoid wearing contact lenses while undergoing therapy for dry eyes.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop using CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS unless your doctor tells you to stop.

name: Cromal Forte Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About CROMAL FORTE EYE DROPS

CROMAL FORTE EYE DROPS contains Sodium Cromoglycate which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-allergy agents. It is used to manage red, watery, itchy eyes caused by allergies like hay fever, house dust mites and pet hair.

It is also used to manage inflammatory conditions of the eye (Ex. vernal keratoconjunctivitis, vernal conjunctivitis, vernal keratitis). You should not wear soft contact lenses while using CROMAL FORTE EYE DROPS. Your doctor may recommend you take relevant tests and examinations to understand your existing condition.

Before using CROMAL FORTE EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or if you are taking any other medicines. CROMAL FORTE EYE DROPS should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women.

Safety and effectiveness of this medicine in children (below the age of 4 years) have not been established. The most common side effect of using CROMAL FORTE EYE DROPS is transient stinging or burning upon instillation. Consult your physician if any of the symptoms get worse.

name: RELIVION Ophthalmic Suspension 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION

RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION contains Nepafenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in adults to manage eye pain and eye inflammation following cataract surgery. It can also be used to manage the risk of macular edema (swelling at the back of the eye) following cataract surgery in diabetic patients.

RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is for ophthalmic use only. Use RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION as instructed by the physician to achieve better results. Avoid wearing contact lenses after undergoing cataract surgery. Your doctor will advise you when you can use contact lenses again.

Before using RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have diabetes, arthritis or bleeding problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from inflammation (such as eye infections, glaucoma etc.).

RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION.

RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. The most common side effects of using RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION are visual disturbances, sensation of a foreign body in the eye and eye irritation. Contact your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage and manage eye pain and inflammation following cataract surgery
Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients
usesDetails:
Uses Of RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION

It is used in adults to:

Manage and manage eye pain and inflammation following cataract surgery
Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients
mechanismOfAction:
How RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION Works

RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is an analgesic medication. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) in the eye that causes inflammation, pain and swelling. As a result, it provides relief from post-surgical eye pain, inflammation and swelling.
usageDetails:
How to use RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION

Use RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only.

Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes. Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of the medicine as directed by your physician.

Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required.

Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.
sideEffects: Sensation of foreign body in the eye
Severe eye pain with redness (inflammation of iris)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION
Common
Visual disturbances
Sensation of foreign body in the eye
Sticky sensation
Uncommon
Eye discomfort
Eyelid crusting or drooping
Rare
Dry eye, eyelid swelling
Itchy eye
Eye discharge
Increased tear production
Dizziness, headache

Stop using RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe eye pain with redness (inflammation of iris)

warnings.details: RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, inform your doctor before using RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION.
RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience blurred vision after using RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION. Wait, until your vision becomes clear.
Do not use RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION if you are allergic to nepafenac or to other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (such as ibuprofen, aspirin, piroxicam, ketoprofen, diclofenac).

RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients who previously developed asthma while using any non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Others

RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is not recommended for use if you:

Had previously experienced any skin allergy or intense inflammation in your nose following the use of any pain relieving medicines

Before using RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you:

Bruise easily or have any bleeding problems
Have an eye infection or any other eye disorders
Have diabetes
Have rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints)
Have had repeated eye surgery within a short period of time

Use in pediatrics:

RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Use in geriatrics:

RELIVION OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

name: Navibrom Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About NAVIBROM EYE DROPS

NAVIBROM EYE DROPS contains Bromfenac, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). It is used in adults for the management of postoperative inflammation and reduction of postoperative eye pain in patients who have undergone cataract surgery.

Cataract can be defined as a condition in which the lens of the eye becomes progressively opaque or cloudy. Symptoms include blurred vision, sensitivity to light/glare, poor night vision, seeing halos around lights, and double vision.

NAVIBROM EYE DROPS should be used with caution in patients having bleeding problems (Ex. haemophilia), rheumatoid arthritis, diabetes, or eye problems (Ex. dry eye syndrome, corneal problems, repeated eye surgery in a short time). Do not wear contact lenses while using the medicine.

NAVIBROM EYE DROPS should not be used during the last three months of pregnancy, and your doctor may advise you to use this medicine only if needed. It can be used in breast-feeding women.

NAVIBROM EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. There is no evidence of safety for NAVIBROM EYE DROPS in elderly patients above 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before using it.

The most common side effects of using NAVIBROM EYE DROPS are increased sensitivity of eyes to light, eye pain, and blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage postoperative inflammation and reduction of postoperative eye pain in patients who have undergone cataract surgery.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NAVIBROM EYE DROPS
Manage postoperative inflammation and reduction of postoperative eye pain in patients who have undergone cataract surgery.
mechanismOfAction:
How NAVIBROM EYE DROPS Works

NAVIBROM EYE DROPS effectively blocks the synthesis of certain substances involved in causing inflammation (prostaglandin). Hence reducing the pain and inflammation after the patient has undergone cataract surgery.
usageDetails:
How to use NAVIBROM EYE DROPS

Use NAVIBROM EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. While using NAVIBROM EYE DROPS, tilt your head back and pull down your lower eyelid. Make sure you wash your hands and do not touch any surface while using it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: BEPOSURGE Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About BEPOSURGE EYE DROPS

BEPOSURGE EYE DROPS contains Bepotastine which belongs to the group of medicines called as Antihistamines. It is indicated in the management of itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis.

Allergic conjunctivitis is a common allergic condition of the eye affecting the outer lining of the eye (conjunctiva) to the particles in the surroundings to which a person is allergic. It can appear as red, watery, itchy, or swollen eyes.

If you use contact lenses, you should remove the contact lenses before using BEPOSURGE EYE DROPS and can put them back after 10 minutes of use.

Before using BEPOSURGE EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart or lung diseases.

BEPOSURGE EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children below 2 years of age. Prior consultation must be taken for the use of BEPOSURGE EYE DROPS in pregnant and breast-feeding women.

The most common side effects of using BEPOSURGE EYE DROPS are mild taste, irritation in the eyes, headache, swelling of nose and throat from inside. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these doesn’t improve or worsen.
uses: Used to manage itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis
usesDetails:
Uses Of BEPOSURGE EYE DROPS
Used to manage itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis
mechanismOfAction:
How BEPOSURGE EYE DROPS Works

BEPOSURGE EYE DROPS belongs to antihistamines which blocks a certain chemical called histamine which is responsible for the allergic reaction. It also supresses the movement of certain cells (eosinophils) into the inflamed (red, swollen) tissue to manage tissue damage and worsening of allergic inflammation of the outer lining of the eyeball.
usageDetails:
How to use BEPOSURGE EYE DROPS

Use BEPOSURGE EYE DROPS as advised by your doctor. It is for ophthalmic use only. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, condition and body weight.

name: Olopat OD Eye Drops 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About OLOPAT OD EYE DROPS

OLOPAT OD EYE DROPS contains Olopatadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis. Seasonal allergic conjunctivitis is an eye inflammation caused due to exposure of eye(s) towards various allergens such as pollens, dusts or molds etc. Symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis may include eye redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production.

Olopatadine is a H1 histamine receptor antagonist. When applied to the eyes, it blocks the release of certain chemicals (Ex. histamines) in the eyes that causes allergic reactions. As a result, it manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).

Use OLOPAT OD EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOPAT OD EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOPAT OD EYE DROPS.

Before using OLOPAT OD EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. OLOPAT OD EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children aged below 3 years.

OLOPAT OD EYE DROPS may make your vision blur after application. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until your vision becomes clear. The most common side effects of using OLOPAT OD EYE DROPS are eye pain or irritation, eye dryness, abnormal sensation in the eyes, headache, dry nose and changes in taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Apply OLOPAT OD EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes.

Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of OLOPAT OD EYE DROPS as directed by your physician. Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same in the other eye if required.

Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOPAT OD EYE DROPS. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOPAT OD EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion.

introduction:
Introduction About DABFIT EYE DROPS

DABFIT EYE DROPS contains Bepotastine which belongs to the group of medicines called as Antihistamines. It is indicated in the management of itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis.

Allergic conjunctivitis is a common allergic condition of the eye affecting the outer lining of the eye (conjunctiva) to the particles in the surroundings to which a person is allergic. It can appear as red, watery, itchy, or swollen eyes.

If you use contact lenses, you should remove the contact lenses before using DABFIT EYE DROPS and can put them back after 10 minutes of use.

Before using DABFIT EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart or lung diseases.

DABFIT EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children below 2 years of age. Prior consultation must be taken for the use of DABFIT EYE DROPS in pregnant and breast-feeding women.

The most common side effects of using DABFIT EYE DROPS are mild taste, irritation in the eyes, headache, swelling of nose and throat from inside. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these doesn’t improve or worsen.

Used to manage itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis

How DABFIT EYE DROPS Works

DABFIT EYE DROPS belongs to antihistamines which blocks a certain chemical called histamine which is responsible for the allergic reaction. It also supresses the movement of certain cells (eosinophils) into the inflamed (red, swollen) tissue to manage tissue damage and worsening of allergic inflammation of the outer lining of the eyeball.

Use DABFIT EYE DROPS as advised by your doctor. It is for ophthalmic use only. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, condition and body weight.

name: Nepastar Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About NEPASTAR

NEPASTAR contains Nepafenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in adults to manage eye pain and eye inflammation following cataract surgery. It can also be used to manage the risk of macular edema (swelling at the back of the eye) following cataract surgery in diabetic patients.

NEPASTAR is for ophthalmic use only. Use NEPASTAR as instructed by the physician to achieve better results. Avoid wearing contact lenses after undergoing cataract surgery. Your doctor will advise you when you can use contact lenses again.

Before using NEPASTAR inform your doctor if you have diabetes, arthritis or bleeding problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from inflammation (such as eye infections, glaucoma etc.).

NEPASTAR is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEPASTAR.

NEPASTAR can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. The most common side effects of using NEPASTAR are visual disturbances, sensation of a foreign body in the eye and eye irritation. Contact your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage and manage eye pain and inflammation following cataract surgery
Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEPASTAR

It is used in adults to:

Manage and manage eye pain and inflammation following cataract surgery
Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients
mechanismOfAction:
How NEPASTAR Works

NEPASTAR is an analgesic medication. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) in the eye that causes inflammation, pain and swelling. As a result, it provides relief from post-surgical eye pain, inflammation and swelling.
usageDetails:
How to use NEPASTAR

Use NEPASTAR as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only.

Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes. Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of the medicine as directed by your physician.

Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required.

Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.
sideEffects: Sensation of foreign body in the eye
Severe eye pain with redness (inflammation of iris)

warnings.details: NEPASTAR is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, inform your doctor before using NEPASTAR if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEPASTAR.
NEPASTAR can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience blurred vision after using NEPASTAR. Wait, until your vision becomes clear.
Do not use NEPASTAR if you are allergic to nepafenac or to other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (such as ibuprofen, aspirin, piroxicam, ketoprofen, diclofenac).
NEPASTAR is not recommended for use in patients who previously developed asthma while using any non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Others

NEPASTAR is not recommended for use if you:

Had previously experienced any skin allergy or intense inflammation in your nose following the use of any pain relieving medicines

Before using NEPASTAR, inform your doctor if you:

Bruise easily or have any bleeding problems
Have an eye infection or any other eye disorders
Have diabetes
Have rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints)
Have had repeated eye surgery within a short period of time

Use in pediatrics:

NEPASTAR is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Use in geriatrics:

NEPASTAR should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

name: Olopat KT Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS

OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS is a combination of Ketorolac and Olopatadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Anti-allergic medicines respectively. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis (an allergic condition causing eye inflammation, redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production). It can also be used to manage eye inflammation and irritation following eye surgeries.

Use OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS.

Before using OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have severe viral or fungal ear/eye infections. You must also inform your doctor if you have dry eyes, diabetes, stomach ulcers or joint pain as a precaution.

Do not use OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS may make your vision blur after application. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until your vision becomes clear.

The most common side effects of using OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS are temporary burning sensation and blurring of vision, mild eye itching, redness and irritation, dry eyes, headache and taste changes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

usesDetails:
Uses Of OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS

It is used to manage and prevent:

mechanismOfAction:
How OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS Works

OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS contains two medicines namely ketorolac and olopatadine. Ketorolac is a pain-relieving medication. It blocks the release of certain chemicals in the body (such as prostaglandins) that causes inflammation, redness and swelling. When applied topically on the eyes, it reduces redness, soreness, pain, itching and swelling.

Olopatadine is an anti-allergic agent. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (such as histamines) in the eye that triggers allergic reactions in the eye.

Collectively, this medicine manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).
usageDetails:
How to use OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS

Use OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Tilt your head slightly backwards and gently pull your lower eyelid. Instil few drops of this medicine into the eyes and close your eyes for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Wash your hands before and after application. Leave a time gap of 5 minutes before applying other medicines on your eyes/ears. Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids, areas around your eyes, outer part of the ears or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. If there is no improvement in your condition even after using this medicine for 7 days, consult your doctor for advice.

OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS should be used with caution in patients who previously developed asthma symptoms while taking an analgesic medicine. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking it.

Wear soft contact lenses
Have a viral or bacterial infection in the eye/ear

Have diabetes
Have rheumatoid arthritis (joint inflammation)
Have dry eyes or corneal problems

OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) unless prescribed by a physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before administration.

Use in Geriatrics:

OLOPAT KT EYE DROPS should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About ALCAREX EYE DROPS

ALCAREX EYE DROPS contains Alcaftadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Ocular antihistamines and decongestants. It is used to manage eye itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis. Allergic conjunctivitis is an eye inflammation caused due to exposure of eye(s) towards various allergens such as pollens, dusts, or molds etc. Symptoms of allergic conjunctivitis may include eye redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production.

Alcaftadine is a H1 histamine receptor antagonist. It blocks the effects of certain chemicals (Ex. histamines) in the body which are responsible for triggering the allergic response. Therefore, when administered into the eyes, it manages the onset of allergic reactions such as eye itching, irritation or inflammation.

Do not use ALCAREX EYE DROPS while wearing soft contact lenses. Make sure to remove them before applying ALCAREX EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. ALCAREX EYE DROPS should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by your physician. The use of ALCAREX EYE DROPS can make you feel drowsy, and so be cautious while you perform tasks that requires complete concentration such as driving or handling heavy tools or machines. Contact your doctor if your eye condition worsens or does not improve after 3 days of use. The most common side effects of using ALCAREX EYE DROPS are eye redness, itching, irritation, burning and/or stinging sensation upon use. Contact your doctor if any of them bothers you.

introduction:
Introduction About KEROSITE MX EYE DROPS

KEROSITE MX EYE DROPS is a combination of Ketorolac and Moxifloxacin which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antibiotics respectively. It is used to manage inflammation and infections of the eyes and ears. It is typically used in conditions which involves inflammation along with the risk of infection such as during injury or post-surgery.

KEROSITE MX EYE DROPS is for external use only. Gently instil few drops of the medicine into the affected eyes/ears. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying KEROSITE MX EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

During management with KEROSITE MX EYE DROPS, your doctor will regularly monitor your eyes for intraocular pressure, cataracts and for infections as a precaution. Before using KEROSITE MX EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have severe viral or fungal ear/eye infections. You must also inform your doctor if you have been managed with a steroid medicine recently, or have dry eyes, diabetes, stomach ulcers or joint pain as a precaution.

Do not use KEROSITE MX EYE DROPS if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using KEROSITE MX EYE DROPS are temporary burning sensation and blurring of vision, mild eye itching, redness and irritation, dry eyes, headache and taste changes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

name: Rapidon OD Eye Drops 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS

RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS contains Olopatadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis. Seasonal allergic conjunctivitis is an eye inflammation caused due to exposure of eye(s) towards various allergens such as pollens, dusts or molds etc. Symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis may include eye redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production.

Olopatadine is a H1 histamine receptor antagonist. When applied to the eyes, it blocks the release of certain chemicals (Ex. histamines) in the eyes that causes allergic reactions. As a result, it manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).

Use RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS.

Before using RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children aged below 3 years.

RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS may make your vision blur after application. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until your vision becomes clear. The most common side effects of using RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS are eye pain or irritation, eye dryness, abnormal sensation in the eyes, headache, dry nose and changes in taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis
usesDetails:
Uses Of RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS
Manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis
mechanismOfAction:
How RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS Works

RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS is an anti-allergic agent. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (such as histamines) in the eye that causes eye inflammation and irritation. As a result, it manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).
usageDetails:
How to use RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS

Apply RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes.

Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS as directed by your physician. Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same in the other eye if required.

Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using RAPIDON OD EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion.

While application, do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

name: RE TEARS Ophthalmic solution 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About RE TEARS OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION

RE TEARS OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION contains Hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, which belongs to the group of medicines called Demulcents. It is used to alleviate dry eye conditions by substituting tear fluid in affected individuals. It is also used to provide temporary relief from burning irritation from dryness of the eye.

RE TEARS OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to hydroxypropyl methylcellulose. It is also not recommended for use if you are undergoing any surgery. Before administering RE TEARS OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you wear contact lenses.

RE TEARS OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and elderly patients. Consult your doctor before using.

The most common side effects of administering RE TEARS OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION are eye irritation/redness, itchy eyes, blurred vision, and/or eye pain. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Provides temporary relief from burning sensation due to dryness of eye

mechanismOfAction:
How RE TEARS OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION Works

RE TEARS OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION is a hydrophilic polymer that works by crosslinking on the eye surface, resulting in increased tear clearance time and promoting eye lubrication, thus providing relief from symptoms associated with eye dryness in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use RE TEARS OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION

Use RE TEARS OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Place the recommended number of gel drops inside the lower eyelid by squeezing the container. Do not use this product if its colour changes or becomes cloudy. Do not touch the container tip to avoid any contamination. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: OLOBET K Ophthalmic Solution 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About OLOBET K OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION

OLOBET K OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION is a combination of Ketorolac and Olopatadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Anti-allergic medicines respectively. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis (an allergic condition causing eye inflammation, redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production). It can also be used to manage eye inflammation and irritation following eye surgeries.

Use OLOBET K OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION as advised by your physician. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOBET K OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOBET K OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION.

Before using OLOBET K OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION inform your doctor if you have severe viral or fungal ear/eye infections. You must also inform your doctor if you have dry eyes, diabetes, stomach ulcers or joint pain as a precaution.

Do not use OLOBET K OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. OLOBET K OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION may make your vision blur after application. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until your vision becomes clear.

The most common side effects of using OLOBET K OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION are temporary burning sensation and blurring of vision, mild eye itching, redness and irritation, dry eyes, headache and taste changes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How OLOBET K OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION Works

OLOBET K OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION contains two medicines namely ketorolac and olopatadine. Ketorolac is a pain-relieving medication. It blocks the release of certain chemicals in the body (such as prostaglandins) that causes inflammation, redness and swelling. When applied topically on the eyes, it reduces redness, soreness, pain, itching and swelling.

Olopatadine is an anti-allergic agent. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (such as histamines) in the eye that triggers allergic reactions in the eye.

Collectively, this medicine manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).
usageDetails:
How to use OLOBET K OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION

Use OLOBET K OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Tilt your head slightly backwards and gently pull your lower eyelid. Instil few drops of this medicine into the eyes and close your eyes for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying OLOBET K OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Wash your hands before and after application. Leave a time gap of 5 minutes before applying other medicines on your eyes/ears. Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids, areas around your eyes, outer part of the ears or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. If there is no improvement in your condition even after using this medicine for 7 days, consult your doctor for advice.

name: NEPAVAC Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About NEPAVAC EYE DROPS

NEPAVAC EYE DROPS contains Nepafenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in adults to manage eye pain and eye inflammation following cataract surgery. It can also be used to manage the risk of macular edema (swelling at the back of the eye) following cataract surgery in diabetic patients.

NEPAVAC EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Use NEPAVAC EYE DROPS as instructed by the physician to achieve better results. Avoid wearing contact lenses after undergoing cataract surgery. Your doctor will advise you when you can use contact lenses again.

Before using NEPAVAC EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, arthritis or bleeding problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from inflammation (such as eye infections, glaucoma etc.).

NEPAVAC EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEPAVAC EYE DROPS.

NEPAVAC EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. The most common side effects of using NEPAVAC EYE DROPS are visual disturbances, sensation of a foreign body in the eye and eye irritation. Contact your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage and manage eye pain and inflammation following cataract surgery
Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEPAVAC EYE DROPS

Manage and manage eye pain and inflammation following cataract surgery
Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients
mechanismOfAction:
How NEPAVAC EYE DROPS Works

NEPAVAC EYE DROPS is an analgesic medication. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) in the eye that causes inflammation, pain and swelling. As a result, it provides relief from post-surgical eye pain, inflammation and swelling.
usageDetails:
How to use NEPAVAC EYE DROPS

Use NEPAVAC EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only.

Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes. Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of the medicine as directed by your physician.

Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required.

Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Therefore, inform your doctor before using NEPAVAC EYE DROPS if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEPAVAC EYE DROPS.
NEPAVAC EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience blurred vision after using NEPAVAC EYE DROPS. Wait, until your vision becomes clear.
Do not use NEPAVAC EYE DROPS if you are allergic to nepafenac or to other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (such as ibuprofen, aspirin, piroxicam, ketoprofen, diclofenac).
NEPAVAC EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients who previously developed asthma while using any non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Others

NEPAVAC EYE DROPS is not recommended for use if you:

Had previously experienced any skin allergy or intense inflammation in your nose following the use of any pain relieving medicines

Before using NEPAVAC EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you:

Bruise easily or have any bleeding problems
Have an eye infection or any other eye disorders
Have diabetes
Have rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints)
Have had repeated eye surgery within a short period of time

Use in pediatrics:

NEPAVAC EYE DROPS is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Use in geriatrics:

NEPAVAC EYE DROPS should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

name: Combipat Sterile Ophthalmic Solution 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About COMBIPAT STERILE OPTHALMIC SOLUTION

COMBIPAT STERILE OPTHALMIC SOLUTION is a combination of Ketorolac and Olopatadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Anti-allergic medicines respectively. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis (an allergic condition causing eye inflammation, redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production). It can also be used to manage eye inflammation and irritation following eye surgeries.

Use COMBIPAT STERILE OPTHALMIC SOLUTION as advised by your physician. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using COMBIPAT STERILE OPTHALMIC SOLUTION and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying COMBIPAT STERILE OPTHALMIC SOLUTION.

Before using COMBIPAT STERILE OPTHALMIC SOLUTION inform your doctor if you have severe viral or fungal ear/eye infections. You must also inform your doctor if you have dry eyes, diabetes, stomach ulcers or joint pain as a precaution.

Do not use COMBIPAT STERILE OPTHALMIC SOLUTION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. COMBIPAT STERILE OPTHALMIC SOLUTION may make your vision blur after application. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until your vision becomes clear.

The most common side effects of using COMBIPAT STERILE OPTHALMIC SOLUTION are temporary burning sensation and blurring of vision, mild eye itching, redness and irritation, dry eyes, headache and taste changes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Uses Of COMBIPAT STERILE OPTHALMIC SOLUTION

It is used to manage and prevent:

Seasonal allergic conjunctivitis (eye inflammation, redness, itching, irritation, watery eyes)

mechanismOfAction:
How COMBIPAT STERILE OPTHALMIC SOLUTION Works

COMBIPAT STERILE OPTHALMIC SOLUTION contains two medicines namely ketorolac and olopatadine. Ketorolac is a pain-relieving medication. It blocks the release of certain chemicals in the body (such as prostaglandins) that causes inflammation, redness and swelling. When applied topically on the eyes, it reduces redness, soreness, pain, itching and swelling.

Olopatadine is an anti-allergic agent. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (such as histamines) in the eye that triggers allergic reactions in the eye.

Collectively, this medicine manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).

Use COMBIPAT STERILE OPTHALMIC SOLUTION as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Tilt your head slightly backwards and gently pull your lower eyelid. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying COMBIPAT STERILE OPTHALMIC SOLUTION and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Wash your hands before and after application. Leave a time gap of 5 minutes before applying other medicines on your eyes/ears. Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids, areas around your eyes, outer part of the ears or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. If there is no improvement in your condition even after using this medicine for 7 days, consult your doctor for advice.
