name: Olotop Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About OLOTOP

OLOTOP contains Olopatadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis. Seasonal allergic conjunctivitis is an eye inflammation caused due to exposure of eye(s) towards various allergens such as pollens, dusts or molds etc. Symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis may include eye redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production.

Olopatadine is a H1 histamine receptor antagonist. When applied to the eyes, it blocks the release of certain chemicals (Ex. histamines) in the eyes that causes allergic reactions. As a result, it manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).

Use OLOTOP as advised by your physician. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOTOP and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOTOP.

Before using OLOTOP inform your doctor if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. OLOTOP is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children aged below 3 years.

OLOTOP may make your vision blur after application. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until your vision becomes clear. The most common side effects of using OLOTOP are eye pain or irritation, eye dryness, abnormal sensation in the eyes, headache, dry nose and changes in taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis
mechanismOfAction:
How OLOTOP Works

OLOTOP is an anti-allergic agent. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (such as histamines) in the eye that causes eye inflammation and irritation. As a result, it manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).
usageDetails:
How to use OLOTOP

Apply OLOTOP as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes.

Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of OLOTOP as directed by your physician. Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same in the other eye if required.

Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOTOP. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOTOP and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion.

While application, do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

name: NEPASTAR OD Eye Drops 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS

NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS contains Nepafenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in adults to manage eye pain and eye inflammation following cataract surgery. It can also be used to manage the risk of macular edema (swelling at the back of the eye) following cataract surgery in diabetic patients.

NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Use NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS as instructed by the physician to achieve better results. Avoid wearing contact lenses after undergoing cataract surgery. Your doctor will advise you when you can use contact lenses again.

Before using NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, arthritis or bleeding problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from inflammation (such as eye infections, glaucoma etc.).

NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS.

NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. The most common side effects of using NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS are visual disturbances, sensation of a foreign body in the eye and eye irritation. Contact your doctor if they trouble you.

Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients

Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required.

Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

warnings.details: NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, inform your doctor before using NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS.
NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience blurred vision after using NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS. Wait, until your vision becomes clear.
Do not use NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS if you are allergic to nepafenac or to other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (such as ibuprofen, aspirin, piroxicam, ketoprofen, diclofenac).
NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients who previously developed asthma while using any non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Others

NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS is not recommended for use if you:

Had previously experienced any skin allergy or intense inflammation in your nose following the use of any pain relieving medicines

Before using NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you:

Bruise easily or have any bleeding problems
Have an eye infection or any other eye disorders
Have diabetes
Have rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints)
Have had repeated eye surgery within a short period of time

Use in pediatrics:

NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Use in geriatrics:

NEPASTAR OD EYE DROPS should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Introduction About BEPOFREE EYE DROPS

BEPOFREE EYE DROPS contains Bepotastine which belongs to the group of medicines called as Antihistamines. It is indicated in the management of itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis.

Allergic conjunctivitis is a common allergic condition of the eye affecting the outer lining of the eye (conjunctiva) to the particles in the surroundings to which a person is allergic. It can appear as red, watery, itchy, or swollen eyes.

If you use contact lenses, you should remove the contact lenses before using BEPOFREE EYE DROPS and can put them back after 10 minutes of use.

Before using BEPOFREE EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart or lung diseases.

BEPOFREE EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children below 2 years of age. Prior consultation must be taken for the use of BEPOFREE EYE DROPS in pregnant and breast-feeding women.

The most common side effects of using BEPOFREE EYE DROPS are mild taste, irritation in the eyes, headache, swelling of nose and throat from inside. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these doesn’t improve or worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How BEPOFREE EYE DROPS Works

BEPOFREE EYE DROPS belongs to antihistamines which blocks a certain chemical called histamine which is responsible for the allergic reaction. It also supresses the movement of certain cells (eosinophils) into the inflamed (red, swollen) tissue to manage tissue damage and worsening of allergic inflammation of the outer lining of the eyeball.

name: MICRONAC PF Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS

MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS contains Nepafenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in adults to manage eye pain and eye inflammation following cataract surgery. It can also be used to manage the risk of macular edema (swelling at the back of the eye) following cataract surgery in diabetic patients.

MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Use MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS as instructed by the physician to achieve better results. Avoid wearing contact lenses after undergoing cataract surgery. Your doctor will advise you when you can use contact lenses again.

Before using MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, arthritis or bleeding problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from inflammation (such as eye infections, glaucoma etc.).

MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS.

MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. The most common side effects of using MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS are visual disturbances, sensation of a foreign body in the eye and eye irritation. Contact your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage and manage eye pain and inflammation following cataract surgery
Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients
usesDetails:
Uses Of MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS

It is used in adults to:

Manage and manage eye pain and inflammation following cataract surgery
Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients
mechanismOfAction:
How MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS Works

MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS is an analgesic medication. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) in the eye that causes inflammation, pain and swelling. As a result, it provides relief from post-surgical eye pain, inflammation and swelling.
usageDetails:
How to use MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS

Use MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only.

Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes. Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of the medicine as directed by your physician.

Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required.

Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.
sideEffects: Sensation of foreign body in the eye
Severe eye pain with redness (inflammation of iris)

warnings.details: MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, inform your doctor before using MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS.
MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience blurred vision after using MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS. Wait, until your vision becomes clear.
Do not use MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS if you are allergic to nepafenac or to other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (such as ibuprofen, aspirin, piroxicam, ketoprofen, diclofenac).
MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients who previously developed asthma while using any non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Others

MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS is not recommended for use if you:

Had previously experienced any skin allergy or intense inflammation in your nose following the use of any pain relieving medicines

Before using MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you:

Bruise easily or have any bleeding problems
Have an eye infection or any other eye disorders
Have diabetes
Have rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints)
Have had repeated eye surgery within a short period of time

MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Use in geriatrics:

MICRONAC PF EYE DROPS should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

name: BROMEDAC 0.09% Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About BROMEDAC 0.09% EYE DROPS

BROMEDAC 0.09% EYE DROPS contains Bromfenac, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). It is used in adults for the management of postoperative inflammation and reduction of postoperative eye pain in patients who have undergone cataract surgery.

Cataract can be defined as a condition in which the lens of the eye becomes progressively opaque or cloudy. Symptoms include blurred vision, sensitivity to light/glare, poor night vision, seeing halos around lights, and double vision.

BROMEDAC 0.09% EYE DROPS should be used with caution in patients having bleeding problems (Ex. haemophilia), rheumatoid arthritis, diabetes, or eye problems (Ex. dry eye syndrome, corneal problems, repeated eye surgery in a short time). Do not wear contact lenses while using the medicine.

BROMEDAC 0.09% EYE DROPS should not be used during the last three months of pregnancy, and your doctor may advise you to use this medicine only if needed. It can be used in breast-feeding women.

BROMEDAC 0.09% EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. There is no evidence of safety for BROMEDAC 0.09% EYE DROPS in elderly patients above 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before using it.

The most common side effects of using BROMEDAC 0.09% EYE DROPS are increased sensitivity of eyes to light, eye pain, and blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About OLOPLUS KT EYE DROPS

OLOPLUS KT EYE DROPS is a combination of Ketorolac and Olopatadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Anti-allergic medicines respectively. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis (an allergic condition causing eye inflammation, redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production). It can also be used to manage eye inflammation and irritation following eye surgeries.

Use OLOPLUS KT EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOPLUS KT EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOPLUS KT EYE DROPS.

Before using OLOPLUS KT EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have severe viral or fungal ear/eye infections. You must also inform your doctor if you have dry eyes, diabetes, stomach ulcers or joint pain as a precaution.

Do not use OLOPLUS KT EYE DROPS if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. OLOPLUS KT EYE DROPS may make your vision blur after application. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until your vision becomes clear.

The most common side effects of using OLOPLUS KT EYE DROPS are temporary burning sensation and blurring of vision, mild eye itching, redness and irritation, dry eyes, headache and taste changes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Seasonal allergic conjunctivitis (eye inflammation, redness, itching, irritation, watery eyes)

mechanismOfAction:
How OLOPLUS KT EYE DROPS Works

OLOPLUS KT EYE DROPS contains two medicines namely ketorolac and olopatadine. Ketorolac is a pain-relieving medication. It blocks the release of certain chemicals in the body (such as prostaglandins) that causes inflammation, redness and swelling. When applied topically on the eyes, it reduces redness, soreness, pain, itching and swelling.

Olopatadine is an anti-allergic agent. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (such as histamines) in the eye that triggers allergic reactions in the eye.

Collectively, this medicine manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).
usageDetails:
How to use OLOPLUS KT EYE DROPS

Use OLOPLUS KT EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Tilt your head slightly backwards and gently pull your lower eyelid. Instil few drops of this medicine into the eyes and close your eyes for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying OLOPLUS KT EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Wash your hands before and after application. Leave a time gap of 5 minutes before applying other medicines on your eyes/ears. Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids, areas around your eyes, outer part of the ears or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. If there is no improvement in your condition even after using this medicine for 7 days, consult your doctor for advice.

Introduction About NEPAWEL EYE DROPS

NEPAWEL EYE DROPS contains Nepafenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in adults to manage eye pain and eye inflammation following cataract surgery. It can also be used to manage the risk of macular edema (swelling at the back of the eye) following cataract surgery in diabetic patients.

NEPAWEL EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Use NEPAWEL EYE DROPS as instructed by the physician to achieve better results. Avoid wearing contact lenses after undergoing cataract surgery. Your doctor will advise you when you can use contact lenses again.

Before using NEPAWEL EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, arthritis or bleeding problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from inflammation (such as eye infections, glaucoma etc.).

NEPAWEL EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEPAWEL EYE DROPS.

NEPAWEL EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. The most common side effects of using NEPAWEL EYE DROPS are visual disturbances, sensation of a foreign body in the eye and eye irritation. Contact your doctor if they trouble you.

name: NEPAVON Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About NEPAVON EYE DROPS

NEPAVON EYE DROPS contains Nepafenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in adults to manage eye pain and eye inflammation following cataract surgery. It can also be used to manage the risk of macular edema (swelling at the back of the eye) following cataract surgery in diabetic patients.

NEPAVON EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Use NEPAVON EYE DROPS as instructed by the physician to achieve better results. Avoid wearing contact lenses after undergoing cataract surgery. Your doctor will advise you when you can use contact lenses again.

Before using NEPAVON EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, arthritis or bleeding problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from inflammation (such as eye infections, glaucoma etc.).

NEPAVON EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEPAVON EYE DROPS.

NEPAVON EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. The most common side effects of using NEPAVON EYE DROPS are visual disturbances, sensation of a foreign body in the eye and eye irritation. Contact your doctor if they trouble you.

Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients

Uses Of NEPAVON EYE DROPS

It is used in adults to:

Manage and manage eye pain and inflammation following cataract surgery
Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients
mechanismOfAction:
How NEPAVON EYE DROPS Works

NEPAVON EYE DROPS is an analgesic medication. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) in the eye that causes inflammation, pain and swelling. As a result, it provides relief from post-surgical eye pain, inflammation and swelling.
usageDetails:
How to use NEPAVON EYE DROPS

Use NEPAVON EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only.

Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes. Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of the medicine as directed by your physician.

Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required.

Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.
sideEffects: Sensation of foreign body in the eye
Severe eye pain with redness (inflammation of iris)

warnings.details: NEPAVON EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, inform your doctor before using NEPAVON EYE DROPS if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEPAVON EYE DROPS.
NEPAVON EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience blurred vision after using NEPAVON EYE DROPS. Wait, until your vision becomes clear.
Do not use NEPAVON EYE DROPS if you are allergic to nepafenac or to other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (such as ibuprofen, aspirin, piroxicam, ketoprofen, diclofenac).
NEPAVON EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients who previously developed asthma while using any non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Others

NEPAVON EYE DROPS is not recommended for use if you:

Had previously experienced any skin allergy or intense inflammation in your nose following the use of any pain relieving medicines

Before using NEPAVON EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you:

Bruise easily or have any bleeding problems
Have an eye infection or any other eye disorders
Have diabetes
Have rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints)
Have had repeated eye surgery within a short period of time

Use in pediatrics:

NEPAVON EYE DROPS is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Use in geriatrics:

NEPAVON EYE DROPS should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

name: OLASIAL Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About OLASIAL EYE DROPS

OLASIAL EYE DROPS contains Olopatadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis. Seasonal allergic conjunctivitis is an eye inflammation caused due to exposure of eye(s) towards various allergens such as pollens, dusts or molds etc. Symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis may include eye redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production.

Olopatadine is a H1 histamine receptor antagonist. When applied to the eyes, it blocks the release of certain chemicals (Ex. histamines) in the eyes that causes allergic reactions. As a result, it manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).

Use OLASIAL EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLASIAL EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLASIAL EYE DROPS.

Before using OLASIAL EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. OLASIAL EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children aged below 3 years.

OLASIAL EYE DROPS may make your vision blur after application. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until your vision becomes clear. The most common side effects of using OLASIAL EYE DROPS are eye pain or irritation, eye dryness, abnormal sensation in the eyes, headache, dry nose and changes in taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About OLOTOP DS EYE DROPS

OLOTOP DS EYE DROPS contains Olopatadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis. Seasonal allergic conjunctivitis is an eye inflammation caused due to exposure of eye(s) towards various allergens such as pollens, dusts or molds etc. Symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis may include eye redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production.

Olopatadine is a H1 histamine receptor antagonist. When applied to the eyes, it blocks the release of certain chemicals (Ex. histamines) in the eyes that causes allergic reactions. As a result, it manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).

Use OLOTOP DS EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOTOP DS EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOTOP DS EYE DROPS.

Before using OLOTOP DS EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. OLOTOP DS EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children aged below 3 years.

OLOTOP DS EYE DROPS may make your vision blur after application. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until your vision becomes clear. The most common side effects of using OLOTOP DS EYE DROPS are eye pain or irritation, eye dryness, abnormal sensation in the eyes, headache, dry nose and changes in taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

usageDetails:
How to use OLOTOP DS EYE DROPS

Apply OLOTOP DS EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes.

Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of OLOTOP DS EYE DROPS as directed by your physician. Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same in the other eye if required.

Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOTOP DS EYE DROPS. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOTOP DS EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion.

While application, do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

name: MAXX TEARS FRESH Eye Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About MAXX TEARS FRESH EYE DROPS

MAXX TEARS FRESH EYE DROPS is a moisturizing solution designed to relieve dry eyes and irritation. The active ingredient, Carboxymethylcellulose 0.5%, helps provide instant hydration and long-lasting lubrication for comfort.

MAXX TEARS FRESH EYE DROPS is typically used as needed. Follow your doctor's instructions regarding the number of drops to use. Allow at least 5-10 minutes before applying any other medication to the same eye to reduce dilution. Do not use the bottle if the seal is broken before opening. Always wash your hands and avoid touching the tip of the dropper to reduce contamination. This medication may need to be used long-term and is safe for extended use as prescribed.

Common side effect of this medication includes eye irritation (including burning and discomfort), eye pain, eye itching, and visual disturbance. These effects are typically temporary and may fade over time. However, if they persist or worsen, inform your doctor. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in any activities that require clear vision until you are confident it is safe to do so. If your condition does not improve or if the side effects become bothersome, consult your doctor.

This medication is unlikely to interact with other medications you are taking. However, inform your doctor if you have a history of glaucoma. Avoid using it while wearing soft contact lenses, and consult your doctor if you experience an eye infection during its use.

Eye irritation
usesDetails:

Dry eyes
Eye irritation
mechanismOfAction:
How MAXX TEARS FRESH EYE DROPS Works

MAXX TEARS FRESH EYE DROPS, which contain carboxymethylcellulose, work by acting as a lubricant for dry eyes. Carboxymethylcellulose is a synthetic polymer that mimics the natural tears in the eye, providing moisture and relief from irritation caused by dryness, environmental factors, or insufficient tear production. When applied, the drops form a protective layer over the surface of the eye, helping to retain moisture, reduce friction during blinking, and alleviate the discomfort associated with dryness. This helps maintain eye comfort and improves the function of the tear film, supporting overall eye health.

introduction:
Introduction About NEPACHEK EYE DROPS

NEPACHEK EYE DROPS contains Nepafenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in adults to manage eye pain and eye inflammation following cataract surgery. It can also be used to manage the risk of macular edema (swelling at the back of the eye) following cataract surgery in diabetic patients.

NEPACHEK EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Use NEPACHEK EYE DROPS as instructed by the physician to achieve better results. Avoid wearing contact lenses after undergoing cataract surgery. Your doctor will advise you when you can use contact lenses again.

Before using NEPACHEK EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, arthritis or bleeding problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from inflammation (such as eye infections, glaucoma etc.).

NEPACHEK EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEPACHEK EYE DROPS.

NEPACHEK EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. The most common side effects of using NEPACHEK EYE DROPS are visual disturbances, sensation of a foreign body in the eye and eye irritation. Contact your doctor if they trouble you.

name: EASYBROM Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About EASYBROM EYE DROPS

EASYBROM EYE DROPS contains Bromfenac, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). It is used in adults for the management of postoperative inflammation and reduction of postoperative eye pain in patients who have undergone cataract surgery.

Cataract can be defined as a condition in which the lens of the eye becomes progressively opaque or cloudy. Symptoms include blurred vision, sensitivity to light/glare, poor night vision, seeing halos around lights, and double vision.

EASYBROM EYE DROPS should be used with caution in patients having bleeding problems (Ex. haemophilia), rheumatoid arthritis, diabetes, or eye problems (Ex. dry eye syndrome, corneal problems, repeated eye surgery in a short time). Do not wear contact lenses while using the medicine.

EASYBROM EYE DROPS should not be used during the last three months of pregnancy, and your doctor may advise you to use this medicine only if needed. It can be used in breast-feeding women.

EASYBROM EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents. There is no evidence of safety for EASYBROM EYE DROPS in elderly patients above 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before using it.

The most common side effects of using EASYBROM EYE DROPS are increased sensitivity of eyes to light, eye pain, and blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage postoperative inflammation and reduction of postoperative eye pain in patients who have undergone cataract surgery.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EASYBROM EYE DROPS
Manage postoperative inflammation and reduction of postoperative eye pain in patients who have undergone cataract surgery.
mechanismOfAction:
How EASYBROM EYE DROPS Works

EASYBROM EYE DROPS effectively blocks the synthesis of certain substances involved in causing inflammation (prostaglandin). Hence reducing the pain and inflammation after the patient has undergone cataract surgery.
usageDetails:
How to use EASYBROM EYE DROPS

Use EASYBROM EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. While using EASYBROM EYE DROPS, tilt your head back and pull down your lower eyelid. Make sure you wash your hands and do not touch any surface while using it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: OLOZEST Ophthalmic Solution 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION

OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION contains Olopatadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis. Seasonal allergic conjunctivitis is an eye inflammation caused due to exposure of eye(s) towards various allergens such as pollens, dusts or molds etc. Symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis may include eye redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production.

Olopatadine is a H1 histamine receptor antagonist. When applied to the eyes, it blocks the release of certain chemicals (Ex. histamines) in the eyes that causes allergic reactions. As a result, it manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).

Use OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION as advised by your physician. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION.

Before using OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION inform your doctor if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children aged below 3 years.

OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION may make your vision blur after application. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until your vision becomes clear. The most common side effects of using OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION are eye pain or irritation, eye dryness, abnormal sensation in the eyes, headache, dry nose and changes in taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION Works

OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION is an anti-allergic agent. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (such as histamines) in the eye that causes eye inflammation and irritation. As a result, it manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).
usageDetails:
How to use OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION

Apply OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes.

Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION as directed by your physician. Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same in the other eye if required.

Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOZEST OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion.

While application, do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS

NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS contains Nepafenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in adults to manage eye pain and eye inflammation following cataract surgery. It can also be used to manage the risk of macular edema (swelling at the back of the eye) following cataract surgery in diabetic patients.

NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Use NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS as instructed by the physician to achieve better results. Avoid wearing contact lenses after undergoing cataract surgery. Your doctor will advise you when you can use contact lenses again.

Before using NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, arthritis or bleeding problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from inflammation (such as eye infections, glaucoma etc.).

NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS.

NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. The most common side effects of using NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS are visual disturbances, sensation of a foreign body in the eye and eye irritation. Contact your doctor if they trouble you.

Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS

It is used in adults to:

Manage and manage eye pain and inflammation following cataract surgery
Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients
mechanismOfAction:
How NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS Works

NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS is an analgesic medication. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) in the eye that causes inflammation, pain and swelling. As a result, it provides relief from post-surgical eye pain, inflammation and swelling.
usageDetails:
How to use NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS

Use NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only.

Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes. Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of the medicine as directed by your physician.

Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required.

Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.
sideEffects: Sensation of foreign body in the eye
Severe eye pain with redness (inflammation of iris)

warnings.details: NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, inform your doctor before using NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS.
NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience blurred vision after using NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS. Wait, until your vision becomes clear.
Do not use NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS if you are allergic to nepafenac or to other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (such as ibuprofen, aspirin, piroxicam, ketoprofen, diclofenac).
NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients who previously developed asthma while using any non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Others

NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS is not recommended for use if you:

Had previously experienced any skin allergy or intense inflammation in your nose following the use of any pain relieving medicines

Before using NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you:

Bruise easily or have any bleeding problems
Have an eye infection or any other eye disorders
Have diabetes
Have rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints)
Have had repeated eye surgery within a short period of time

NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Use in geriatrics:

NEPAVON CS EYE DROPS should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

name: OLARIN Eye drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About OLARIN EYE DROPS

OLARIN EYE DROPS contains Olopatadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis. Seasonal allergic conjunctivitis is an eye inflammation caused due to exposure of eye(s) towards various allergens such as pollens, dusts or molds etc. Symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis may include eye redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production.

Olopatadine is a H1 histamine receptor antagonist. When applied to the eyes, it blocks the release of certain chemicals (Ex. histamines) in the eyes that causes allergic reactions. As a result, it manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).

Use OLARIN EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLARIN EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLARIN EYE DROPS.

Before using OLARIN EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. OLARIN EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children aged below 3 years.

OLARIN EYE DROPS may make your vision blur after application. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until your vision becomes clear. The most common side effects of using OLARIN EYE DROPS are eye pain or irritation, eye dryness, abnormal sensation in the eyes, headache, dry nose and changes in taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

name: 4 QUIN KT Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About 4 QUIN KT EYE DROPS

4 QUIN KT EYE DROPS is a combination of Ketorolac and Moxifloxacin which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antibiotics respectively. It is used to manage inflammation and infections of the eyes and ears. It is typically used in conditions which involves inflammation along with the risk of infection such as during injury or post-surgery.

4 QUIN KT EYE DROPS is for external use only. Gently instil few drops of the medicine into the affected eyes/ears. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying 4 QUIN KT EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

During management with 4 QUIN KT EYE DROPS, your doctor will regularly monitor your eyes for intraocular pressure, cataracts and for infections as a precaution. Before using 4 QUIN KT EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have severe viral or fungal ear/eye infections. You must also inform your doctor if you have been managed with a steroid medicine recently, or have dry eyes, diabetes, stomach ulcers or joint pain as a precaution.

Do not use 4 QUIN KT EYE DROPS if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using 4 QUIN KT EYE DROPS are temporary burning sensation and blurring of vision, mild eye itching, redness and irritation, dry eyes, headache and taste changes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage and manages eye/ear infection and inflammation
usesDetails:
Uses Of 4 QUIN KT EYE DROPS
Manage and manages eye/ear infection and inflammation
mechanismOfAction:
How 4 QUIN KT EYE DROPS Works

4 QUIN KT EYE DROPS contains two medicines namely, Ketorolac and Moxifloxacin. Ketorolac is a pain-relieving medication. It blocks the release of certain chemicals in the body (such as prostaglandins) that causes inflammation, redness and swelling. When applied topically on the eyes or ears, it reduces redness, soreness, pain, itching and swelling.

Moxifloxacin is an antibiotic. When applied topically on the eyes or ears, it kills the susceptible bacteria that causes infection. Collectively, this medicine reduces inflammation and infection of the eyes and ears.
usageDetails:
How to use 4 QUIN KT EYE DROPS

Use 4 QUIN KT EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for topical use only.

For Eyes: Tilt your head slightly backwards and gently pull your lower eyelid. Instil few drops of this medicine into the eyes and close your eyes for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying 4 QUIN KT EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

For Ears: Gently instil few drops of this medicine into the ears. Repeat the same for the other ear if required.

Wash your hands before and after application. Leave a time gap of 5 minutes before applying other medicines on your eyes/ears. Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids, areas around your eyes, outer part of the ears or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. If there is no improvement in your condition even after using this medicine for 7 days, consult your doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About LOT LS EYE DROPS

LOT LS EYE DROPS is used for the short term relief of signs and symptoms (itching and redness in the eye) of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis due to pollens. It contains Loteprednol which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids.

LOT LS EYE DROPS is not recommended for use if you have any eye diseases caused by viruses (such as herpes simplex, vaccinia, and varicella), or caused by bacteria or a fungus, have glaucoma or any other eye infection. LOT LS EYE DROPS is not recommend for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice. LOT LS EYE DROPS is not suitable for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age.

After instilling LOT LS EYE DROPS you must wait at least 10 to 15 minutes before inserting your contact lenses. Do not wear a contact lens if your eye is red. The most common side effects associated with use of LOT LS EYE DROPS are increased pressure within the eye, blurred or abnormal vision. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects bothers you.

introduction:
Introduction About EPITRATE INJECTION

EPITRATE INJECTION contains Adrenaline which belongs to the group of medicines called Sympathomimetics. It is used during emergency situations to manage severe allergic reactions (anaphylaxis), cardiac arrest (loss of heart functions) and anaphylactic shock (sudden drop in blood flow due to an allergic reaction).

Anaphylaxis can be defined as a severe, potential life-threatening medical condition characterized by severe decrease in blood pressure, heart function, skin rash, nausea, swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat causing difficulty in breathing or swallowing. It is caused when an individual accidentally gets exposed towards certain chemicals (such as insect stings or bites, foods, drugs, sera, diagnostic testing substances and other allergens) that can trigger an allergic reaction in him.

EPITRATE INJECTION can also be used to increase blood pressure in patients suffering from low blood pressure caused due to septic shock. It also helps in inducing mydriasis (dilation of the pupils) prior to an eye surgery after diluting the medicine properly using an ophthalmic irrigating solution.

Before receiving EPITRATE INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or severe heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, hypertension, glaucoma, thyroid disorders, atherosclerosis, or any other brain disorders.

Inform your doctor before receiving EPITRATE INJECTION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The common side effects of receiving EPITRATE INJECTION are tremors, pounding heartbeat, headache, sweating or dizziness. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How EPITRATE INJECTION Works

EPITRATE INJECTION is a powerful cardiac stimulant. It works by binding to the alpha and beta receptors of the adrenergic system. This action, stimulates the heart, improves heart functions, and helps the heart to pump more blood smoothly. It also increases blood pressure among patients suffering from low blood pressure. It is also a powerful bronchodilator which relaxes the smooth muscle of the airway tract. This helps in reducing breathing difficulties caused due to anaphylactic reactions.
usageDetails:
How to use EPITRATE INJECTION

EPITRATE INJECTION will be given only by a doctor or by a trained healthcare professional into the vein (intravenously) or into the muscle (intramuscularly) or under the skin (subcutaneously on the anterior part of the thigh).

It may also be administered into the eye (intracamerally) by an ophthalmologist prior to an eye surgery after diluting the medicine properly using an ophthalmic irrigating solution to cause pupil dilation.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration of therapy and site of administration for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. However, care should be taken to not to administer EPITRATE INJECTION in areas which generally have low blood supply (such as fingers, toes, ears, nose, genitals, or buttocks).

Introduction About OCUREST EYE DROPS

OCUREST EYE DROPS is a combination of Phenylephrine, Naphazoline, Camphor and Menthol which belongs to the group of medicines called Vasoconstrictor, Decongestant, Cooling and Soothing agents respectively. It is indicated for temporary relief of the minor eye symptoms of itching and redness caused by dust, smoke, sun glare, ragweed, pollen, grass, animal hair and dander, symptomatic relief to tearing, photophobia, redness, swelling, blepharospasm and controlling hyperaemia of the palpebral and bulbar conjunctiva resulting from bacterial, allergic and vernal conjunctivitis.

Your doctor may advise you to undergo relevant tests and examinations to understand your condition. OCUREST EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients with narrow-angle glaucoma of the eye. Before using OCUREST EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have heart or kidney disease, difficulty in passing urine, prostate enlargement, impaired vision, nasal congestion.

OCUREST EYE DROPS should be used in pregnant women and breastfeeding mothers, only if recommended by your doctor. The most common side effects of OCUREST EYE DROPS includes rebound congestion. Consult your doctor immediately or visit a nearby hospital if any of the symptoms worsen or persists for a longer duration.

mechanismOfAction:
How OCUREST EYE DROPS Works

OCUREST EYE DROPS is a combination of Phenylephrine, Naphazoline, Camphor and Menthol. phenylephrine acts directly on α-adrenergic receptors in the eye, producing contraction of the dilator muscle of the pupil and constriction of the arterioles in the conjunctiva. Naphazoline works by constricting the blood vessels and relieves itching sensation and irritation of the eye. Menthol works by activating cold-sensitive receptors which causes a cold sensation and it may also relieve pain by activating the kappa-opioid receptor. Camphor works by providing a cooling and soothing effect.

name: NEPCINAC Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About NEPCINAC EYE DROPS

NEPCINAC EYE DROPS contains Nepafenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in adults to manage eye pain and eye inflammation following cataract surgery. It can also be used to manage the risk of macular edema (swelling at the back of the eye) following cataract surgery in diabetic patients.

NEPCINAC EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Use NEPCINAC EYE DROPS as instructed by the physician to achieve better results. Avoid wearing contact lenses after undergoing cataract surgery. Your doctor will advise you when you can use contact lenses again.

Before using NEPCINAC EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, arthritis or bleeding problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from inflammation (such as eye infections, glaucoma etc.).

NEPCINAC EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEPCINAC EYE DROPS.

NEPCINAC EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. The most common side effects of using NEPCINAC EYE DROPS are visual disturbances, sensation of a foreign body in the eye and eye irritation. Contact your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage and manage eye pain and inflammation following cataract surgery
Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients
usesDetails:
Uses Of NEPCINAC EYE DROPS

It is used in adults to:

Manage and manage eye pain and inflammation following cataract surgery
Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients
mechanismOfAction:
How NEPCINAC EYE DROPS Works

NEPCINAC EYE DROPS is an analgesic medication. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) in the eye that causes inflammation, pain and swelling. As a result, it provides relief from post-surgical eye pain, inflammation and swelling.
usageDetails:
How to use NEPCINAC EYE DROPS

Use NEPCINAC EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only.

Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes. Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of the medicine as directed by your physician.

Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required.

Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.
sideEffects: Sensation of foreign body in the eye
Severe eye pain with redness (inflammation of iris)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of NEPCINAC EYE DROPS
Common
Visual disturbances
Sensation of foreign body in the eye
Sticky sensation
Uncommon
Eye discomfort
Eyelid crusting or drooping
Rare
Dry eye, eyelid swelling
Itchy eye
Eye discharge
Increased tear production
Dizziness, headache

Stop using NEPCINAC EYE DROPS and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe eye pain with redness (inflammation of iris)

warnings.details: NEPCINAC EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, inform your doctor before using NEPCINAC EYE DROPS if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEPCINAC EYE DROPS.
NEPCINAC EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience blurred vision after using NEPCINAC EYE DROPS. Wait, until your vision becomes clear.
Do not use NEPCINAC EYE DROPS if you are allergic to nepafenac or to other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory medicines (such as ibuprofen, aspirin, piroxicam, ketoprofen, diclofenac).
NEPCINAC EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients who previously developed asthma while using any non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Others

NEPCINAC EYE DROPS is not recommended for use if you:

Had previously experienced any skin allergy or intense inflammation in your nose following the use of any pain relieving medicines

Before using NEPCINAC EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you:

Bruise easily or have any bleeding problems
Have an eye infection or any other eye disorders
Have diabetes
Have rheumatoid arthritis (inflammation of joints)
Have had repeated eye surgery within a short period of time

Use in pediatrics:

NEPCINAC EYE DROPS is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

Use in geriatrics:

NEPCINAC EYE DROPS should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Therefore, consult your doctor before application.

introduction:
Introduction About IMUDROPS SINGULES EYE DROPS

IMUDROPS SINGULES EYE DROPS contains Cyclosporin which belongs to the group of medicines called Immunosuppressants.  It is used to manage severe dry eye syndrome (keratoconjunctivitis sicca) in children and in adolescents (aged between 4-18 years).

Dry Eye Syndrome (also known as keratoconjunctivitis sicca) is an allergic eye condition that affects the transparent layer in the front part of the eye and the thin membrane covering the front part of the eye. It is characterized by excessive eye dryness, redness, itching, inflammation and discomfort. Persons having dry eye syndrome do not produce sufficient tears to lubricate and nourish the eyes.

IMUDROPS SINGULES EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before and after application. Avoid touching the tip of the container with your mouth, nose or other parts of body to avoid contamination.

If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using IMUDROPS SINGULES EYE DROPS. Consult your doctor about the usage of contact lenses while undergoing management for dry eyes.

Before using IMUDROPS SINGULES EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any other eye conditions apart from dry eye syndrome such as eye infection or glaucoma. IMUDROPS SINGULES EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients having cancer in and around the eye areas. Consult your doctor before using IMUDROPS SINGULES EYE DROPS if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using IMUDROPS SINGULES EYE DROPS are eye pain, redness, irritation or discomfort, watery eyes and blurred vision. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage severe dry eye syndrome
usesDetails:
Uses Of IMUDROPS SINGULES EYE DROPS
Manage severe dry eye syndrome
mechanismOfAction:
How IMUDROPS SINGULES EYE DROPS Works

IMUDROPS SINGULES EYE DROPS is an immunosuppressive agent. Following application on the eyes, it blocks the release of certain chemicals in the eye (such as T-cells, interleukins and cytokines) that causes eye inflammation, allergies and discomfort. As a result, it reduces inflammation and swelling on the eye and keeps your eyes lubricated by allowing your eye to produce tears.
usageDetails:
How to use IMUDROPS SINGULES EYE DROPS

Use IMUDROPS SINGULES EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes.

Gently pull your lower eyelid and instil few drops of the medicine as directed by your physician. Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required.

Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination. Avoid wearing contact lenses while undergoing therapy for dry eyes.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop using IMUDROPS SINGULES EYE DROPS unless your doctor tells you to stop.

name: KETOROVAC OF Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About KETOROVAC OF EYE DROPS

KETOROVAC OF EYE DROPS is a combination of Ketorolac and Ofloxacin which belongs to the group of medicines called Analgesics and Antibiotics respectively. It is used to manage eye inflammation and infection. It helps in reducing eye pain, redness, itching and burning/stinging sensation following eye surgery (such as cataract surgery or corneal refractive surgery). It is typically used in eye conditions which involves the risk of both eye inflammation and infection such as during injury or post-surgery.

KETOROVAC OF EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Gently instil few drops of the medicine into the affected eyes. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying KETOROVAC OF EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using KETOROVAC OF EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have severe viral or fungal ear/eye infections. You must also inform your doctor if you have any eye defects, dry eyes, diabetes, stomach ulcers, joint pain or low blood potassium or magnesium levels as a precaution.

Do not use KETOROVAC OF EYE DROPS if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using KETOROVAC OF EYE DROPS are temporary burning sensation and blurring of vision, mild eye itching, redness and irritation, dry eyes, headache and blurred vision. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How KETOROVAC OF EYE DROPS Works

KETOROVAC OF EYE DROPS contains two medicines namely, Ketorolac and Ofloxacin. Ketorolac is a pain-relieving medication. It blocks the release of certain chemicals in the body (such as prostaglandins) that causes inflammation, redness and swelling. When applied topically on the eyes, it reduces eye redness, soreness, pain, itching and swelling.

Ofloxacin is an antibiotic. When applied topically on the eyes, it kills the susceptible bacteria that causes eye infection. Collectively, this medicine reduces eye inflammation and pain and manages the risk of eye infections.
usageDetails:
How to use KETOROVAC OF EYE DROPS

Use KETOROVAC OF EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Tilt your head slightly backwards and gently pull your lower eyelid. Instil few drops of this medicine into the eyes and close your eyes for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying KETOROVAC OF EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Wash your hands before and after application. Leave a time gap of 5 minutes before applying other medicines on your eyes. Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids, areas around your eyes, ears or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About I GESIC 0.10% EYE DROPS

I GESIC 0.10% EYE DROPS contains Diclofenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs). It is used to control pain and inflammation before eye surgery, to help keep the pupil open during surgery, or post-eye surgery or injury.

I GESIC 0.10% EYE DROPS is also used to reduce the symptoms associated with seasonal allergic conjunctivitis (hay fever) such as red, runny or itchy eyes.

Before using I GESIC 0.10% EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any allergies, bleeding disorders, eye problems, or if you wear contact lenses. I GESIC 0.10% EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnancy (especially in last 3 months). It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

I GESIC 0.10% EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children (below 18 years of age). The most common side effects of using I GESIC 0.10% EYE DROPS are eye pain, irritation, itching, etc. Call your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

name: OLOGUARD Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About OLOGUARD EYE DROPS

OLOGUARD EYE DROPS contains Olopatadine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihistamines. It is used to manage signs and symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis. Seasonal allergic conjunctivitis is an eye inflammation caused due to exposure of eye(s) towards various allergens such as pollens, dusts or molds etc. Symptoms of seasonal allergic conjunctivitis may include eye redness, itching or irritation with excessive tear production.

Olopatadine is a H1 histamine receptor antagonist. When applied to the eyes, it blocks the release of certain chemicals (Ex. histamines) in the eyes that causes allergic reactions. As a result, it manages the onset of allergic reactions in the eye and provides relief from the unpleasant symptoms associated with allergic conjunctivitis (such as eye itching, irritation and inflammation).

Use OLOGUARD EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOGUARD EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion. Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOGUARD EYE DROPS.

Before using OLOGUARD EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. OLOGUARD EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and in children aged below 3 years.

OLOGUARD EYE DROPS may make your vision blur after application. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until your vision becomes clear. The most common side effects of using OLOGUARD EYE DROPS are eye pain or irritation, eye dryness, abnormal sensation in the eyes, headache, dry nose and changes in taste. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Apply OLOGUARD EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes.

Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of OLOGUARD EYE DROPS as directed by your physician. Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same in the other eye if required.

Leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointments after applying OLOGUARD EYE DROPS. If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using OLOGUARD EYE DROPS and wait for at least 10 minutes before reinsertion.

While application, do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NEPAVAC PF EYE DROPS

NEPAVAC PF EYE DROPS contains Nepafenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in adults to manage eye pain and eye inflammation following cataract surgery. It can also be used to manage the risk of macular edema (swelling at the back of the eye) following cataract surgery in diabetic patients.

NEPAVAC PF EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Use NEPAVAC PF EYE DROPS as instructed by the physician to achieve better results. Avoid wearing contact lenses after undergoing cataract surgery. Your doctor will advise you when you can use contact lenses again.

Before using NEPAVAC PF EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, arthritis or bleeding problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from inflammation (such as eye infections, glaucoma etc.).

NEPAVAC PF EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NEPAVAC PF EYE DROPS.

NEPAVAC PF EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. The most common side effects of using NEPAVAC PF EYE DROPS are visual disturbances, sensation of a foreign body in the eye and eye irritation. Contact your doctor if they trouble you.

introduction:
Introduction About CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS

CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS contains Cyclosporin which belongs to the group of medicines called Immunosuppressants.  It is used to manage severe dry eye syndrome (keratoconjunctivitis sicca) in children and in adolescents (aged between 4-18 years).

Dry Eye Syndrome (also known as keratoconjunctivitis sicca) is an allergic eye condition that affects the transparent layer in the front part of the eye and the thin membrane covering the front part of the eye. It is characterized by excessive eye dryness, redness, itching, inflammation and discomfort. Persons having dry eye syndrome do not produce sufficient tears to lubricate and nourish the eyes.

CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before and after application. Avoid touching the tip of the container with your mouth, nose or other parts of body to avoid contamination.

If you wear soft contact lenses, make sure to remove them before using CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS. Consult your doctor about the usage of contact lenses while undergoing management for dry eyes.

Before using CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any other eye conditions apart from dry eye syndrome such as eye infection or glaucoma. CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients having cancer in and around the eye areas. Consult your doctor before using CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of using CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS are eye pain, redness, irritation or discomfort, watery eyes and blurred vision. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage severe dry eye syndrome
usesDetails:

Manage severe dry eye syndrome
mechanismOfAction:
How CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS Works

CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS is an immunosuppressive agent. Following application on the eyes, it blocks the release of certain chemicals in the eye (such as T-cells, interleukins and cytokines) that causes eye inflammation, allergies and discomfort. As a result, it reduces inflammation and swelling on the eye and keeps your eyes lubricated by allowing your eye to produce tears.

Use CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes.

Gently pull your lower eyelid and instil few drops of the medicine as directed by your physician. Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required.

Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination. Avoid wearing contact lenses while undergoing therapy for dry eyes.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop using CYCLOMUNE 0.1% EYE DROPS unless your doctor tells you to stop.

name: BOTAS 1.5% Ophthalmic Solution 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About BOTAS 1.5% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION

BOTAS 1.5% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION contains Bepotastine which belongs to the group of medicines called as Antihistamines. It is indicated in the management of itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis.

Allergic conjunctivitis is a common allergic condition of the eye affecting the outer lining of the eye (conjunctiva) to the particles in the surroundings to which a person is allergic. It can appear as red, watery, itchy, or swollen eyes.

If you use contact lenses, you should remove the contact lenses before using BOTAS 1.5% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION and can put them back after 10 minutes of use.

Before using BOTAS 1.5% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION inform your doctor if you have any kidney, liver, heart or lung diseases.

BOTAS 1.5% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION is not recommended for use in children below 2 years of age. Prior consultation must be taken for the use of BOTAS 1.5% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION in pregnant and breast-feeding women.

The most common side effects of using BOTAS 1.5% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION are mild taste, irritation in the eyes, headache, swelling of nose and throat from inside. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these doesn’t improve or worsen.
uses: Used to manage itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis
usesDetails:
Uses Of BOTAS 1.5% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION
Used to manage itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis
mechanismOfAction:
How BOTAS 1.5% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION Works

BOTAS 1.5% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION belongs to antihistamines which blocks a certain chemical called histamine which is responsible for the allergic reaction. It also supresses the movement of certain cells (eosinophils) into the inflamed (red, swollen) tissue to manage tissue damage and worsening of allergic inflammation of the outer lining of the eyeball.
usageDetails:
How to use BOTAS 1.5% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION

Use BOTAS 1.5% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION as advised by your doctor. It is for ophthalmic use only. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, condition and body weight.

name: NOTIN Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About NOTIN EYE DROPS

NOTIN EYE DROPS contains Nepafenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in adults to manage eye pain and eye inflammation following cataract surgery. It can also be used to manage the risk of macular edema (swelling at the back of the eye) following cataract surgery in diabetic patients.

NOTIN EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Use NOTIN EYE DROPS as instructed by the physician to achieve better results. Avoid wearing contact lenses after undergoing cataract surgery. Your doctor will advise you when you can use contact lenses again.

Before using NOTIN EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have diabetes, arthritis or bleeding problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from inflammation (such as eye infections, glaucoma etc.).

NOTIN EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Women of child-bearing potential must use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with NOTIN EYE DROPS.

NOTIN EYE DROPS can be used in breastfeeding women if prescribed by the doctor. The most common side effects of using NOTIN EYE DROPS are visual disturbances, sensation of a foreign body in the eye and eye irritation. Contact your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage and manage eye pain and inflammation following cataract surgery
Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOTIN EYE DROPS

It is used in adults to:

Manage and manage eye pain and inflammation following cataract surgery
Prevent the risk of macular oedema following cataract surgery in diabetic patients
mechanismOfAction:
How NOTIN EYE DROPS Works

NOTIN EYE DROPS is an analgesic medication. It works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers (prostaglandins) in the eye that causes inflammation, pain and swelling. As a result, it provides relief from post-surgical eye pain, inflammation and swelling.
usageDetails:
How to use NOTIN EYE DROPS

Use NOTIN EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only.

Wash your hands before application. Tilt your head slightly backwards and place the tip of the container close to your eyes. Gently pull your lower eyelid and instill few drops of the medicine as directed by your physician.

Close your eyes and gently press the inner corner of your eye for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required.

Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids or areas around your eyes or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.
sideEffects: Sensation of foreign body in the eye
Severe eye pain with redness (inflammation of iris)
